message.reasoning_content:
need to determine the crime(s) based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: defendant was a school cashier, misappropriated public funds (school funds) 10+ times, total 332,600 RMB, stored in personal bank account, used to buy stocks, later returned all money before being caught. He confessed.

This is classic "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 382 (formerly 382) for "挪用公款罪". The amount 332,600 RMB qualifies as "数额较大" (relatively large) maybe "数额巨大"? According to thresholds: For public funds, "数额较大" is 10,000-50,000? Actually thresholds: For embezzlement of public funds, "数额较大" is 10,000-50,000 RMB, "数额巨大" is 50,000-500,000, "数额特别巨大" >500,000. So 332,600 is "数额巨大". So crime: "挪用公款罪". Also possibly "职务侵占罪"? No, that's for non-public funds. Since it's public funds, it's "挪用公款罪". Also maybe "非法吸收公众存款"? No. So single crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]挪用公款罪<eoa>.
